what_this_is: The Workshop rows for tools/formula-engine: keep the rows that match a person's rules, evaluate a formula over rows, list the comparisons a rule can use, and give a record the label of the first rule that holds. Each runs the formula engine as one WebAssembly component (built-stored-bytes/component/formula-engine.wasm), which every computer's engine runs whatever its system; the component reads only the request on standard input.

payload.label: Keep the rows that match my rules
payload.job: Keep the rows of a list that match my rules: a tree of comparisons (is any of, has all of, contains, is more than, is between, is empty, is known and more) joined by all-of and any-of groups, each group optionally negated
payload.description: Takes records, the fields the rules may read (an id, a kind and a path into each record) and a rule tree. Answers the positions and the records that match, the field ids the rules read and the rules left out because they are not finished (an unknown field or comparison, a comparison the field's kind does not offer, missing values), never guessing at them. A tree with no finished rule keeps every row. A value that is unknown never matches a comparison that cannot tell (contains, starts with, more than, less than, between and the like) nor its negation (does not contain, has none of), but an unknown value is simply not in a list and not equal to a word, so is none of and is not keep it. A group whose combinator is not one of the listed ones is refused with a sentence. A row whose value is of the wrong kind for a comparison is counted in error_rows and left out. The comparisons are rows of data: send operators to add or change them, or leave it out to use the ones list-comparisons shows.

id.description: The name rules use for this field

kind.description: Which comparisons the field offers (see list-comparisons)

path.description: Keys and positions into a record; the id by default

tree.description: A group { kind: group, combinator, negate, rules } or a rule { kind: rule, field, operator, params }; left out means every row

operators.description: Comparisons and combinators as rows of data, replacing the built-in ones

provenance.source: tools/formula-engine/crates/formula-engine: the rule compiler, guards, classifier and the ops-core evaluator, built for wasm32-wasip2 as one component

payload.label: Evaluate a formula over rows
payload.job: Evaluate a formula over each row of a list: read a value from the row, then run a pipeline of steps (and, or, not, equals, more than, less than, is in a list, position in a list, lower-case, contains, starts with, join, is empty, is unknown) over it
payload.description: Takes a binding (select from the row at a path, or a stated literal, then a transform list of { op, args }; an argument may itself be a binding evaluated over the value the step receives) and rows. Answers one value per row, in order, and the rows that could not be evaluated with the reason (a step given a value of the wrong kind, or a step that is not supported). Three-state logic: and, or and not answer true, false or unknown, and a comparison with an unknown side is unknown. Nothing outside the row is read.

binding.description: { $kind: binding, select: { from: self, path: [...] }, transform: [{ op, args }], default? }

rows.description: The values to evaluate the binding over

provenance.source: tools/formula-engine/crates/formula-engine: the rule compiler, guards, classifier and the ops-core evaluator, built for wasm32-wasip2 as one component

payload.label: List the comparisons a rule can use
payload.job: List the comparisons and the all-of and any-of groups a rule can use, for one kind of field or every kind
payload.description: Answers each comparison's id, its label, what it takes (nothing, one value, a list of values, words, text, a day or a range) and the field kinds that offer it, the group combinators, and the field kinds known. Send operators to list a person's own comparison rows instead of the built-in ones.

field_kind.description: Only the comparisons this kind of field offers

operators.description: Comparison rows to list instead of the built-in ones

provenance.source: tools/formula-engine/crates/formula-engine: the rule compiler, guards, classifier and the ops-core evaluator, built for wasm32-wasip2 as one component

payload.label: Give a record the label of the first rule it meets
payload.job: Give a record the label of the first of my rules that holds: each rule has clauses over facts read from the record (is present, is absent, at least, at most, equals), and I get the rule's key, label, tone and severity, or none
payload.description: Takes a record, the facts to read from it (a key, a path, and how to read it: present, as a number, as an age in seconds up to now_ms, or as it is) and rules in order (a key, a label, an optional tone and severity, and clauses over facts). Answers the first rule whose clauses all hold, with its key, label, tone and severity exactly as given (null where none was given), or no result when none holds. A request that is unfinished (a rule with no key, label or clause, a clause naming a fact that was not declared, an operator that is not listed, an age fact with no now_ms) is refused with a sentence. The tool names no label, tone or threshold; the clock is now_ms, never read.

path.description: Names and list positions into the record

now_ms.description: The time an age-seconds fact is measured to; required when one is declared
